rules.expected: Mapped ring-plane angle and every continuous linker torsion are correctly and separately extracted; noncoplanar geometry is evaluated without a mismatched hard angle target.

binding.comparison: Re-extract from each validated final geometry using the public atom maps and plane/sign definitions. Source 75.2/81.6/77.1 are not ring-plane targets. PFMB torsion uses bonded 2-3-12-13, never nonbonded 4-12 as center.

Resolve identities, then assess global index ordering ODA > 6FODA > PFMB; distinguish local-descriptor rankings and allow evidence-backed disagreements with analysis, not silent descriptor substitution.

rules.expected: The fixed diamine set has a reproducible comparative reactivity analysis from the global TCE-referenced nucleophilicity index, separately defined local indicators and mapped geometry. An evidence-backed disagreement with the source ordering remains admissible. Distinguish global and local descriptor rankings and distinguish ring-plane angles from linker torsions. The source four-atom angle numbers are not hard ring-plane targets; geometry must be re-extractable from validated coordinates.

Missing/failed/incomparable values do not establish numeric success; do not fabricate them to evaluate bounded failure.
